title: M/s Suchi Paper Mills Ltd. v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J. and Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed following connected Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016
headnote: Challenge to additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 dismissed by adopting the order of even date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.
facts: The petitioner, a paper mill, challenged Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.'s demand of additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ was tagged with M/s Vehina Steels & Alloys Pvt. Ltd. (W.P. No. 30582 of 2009) and similar matters. An interim order of 3 July 2013 restrained the demand of additional security, without prejudice. On 21 March 2017 the petition was dismissed by the Chief Justice's Court with reference to the order of even date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.

holding_units.holding: The writ challenging the licensee's demand of additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 is dismissed, following the order of even date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.
